_source: Verbatim copies of two pivota-backend constants, rendered by importing them (not retyped): services/catalog_row_trust_upserter.py CRAWL_ROW_PRICE_READ_SQL and services/external_offer_dual_write.py PRICE_CHECK_COLUMN_SQL, from pivota-backend commit bc4b0eb0b (CRAWL_FRESH round 5, PR #2656). The gateway twin (src/services/catalogRowTrustUpserter.js) must emit the same bytes, except for the bind tokens: the backend binds :product_keys and :now (SQLAlchemy) where node-pg binds $1 and $2. If the backend constant changes, re-render this file from it; never hand-edit.
CRAWL_ROW_PRICE_READ_SQL:
SELECT k.product_key, r.row_price_read_at
  FROM unnest(CAST(:product_keys AS text[])) AS k(product_key)
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) > 0
                AND bool_and((CASE WHEN co.source_system = 'catalog_enrichment_agent_v1' AND (upper(btrim(coalesce(co.market, ''))), upper(btrim(coalesce(co.currency, '')))) IN (('SG', 'SGD'), ('US', 'USD')) AND coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'validated_at', '') NOT LIKE 'affiliate_feed:%' AND co.price_checked_at <= CAST(:now AS timestamptz) AND upper(btrim(coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'declared_market', ''))) = upper(btrim(coalesce(co.market, ''))) AND coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'price_read_source', '') <> 'employee_edit' THEN co.price_checked_at END) IS NOT NULL)
                AND bool_or(lower(btrim(coalesce(co.availability, ''))) NOT IN ('out_of_stock', 'outofstock', 'sold_out', 'soldout', 'unavailable'))
               THEN min(CASE WHEN co.source_system = 'catalog_enrichment_agent_v1' AND (upper(btrim(coalesce(co.market, ''))), upper(btrim(coalesce(co.currency, '')))) IN (('SG', 'SGD'), ('US', 'USD')) AND coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'validated_at', '') NOT LIKE 'affiliate_feed:%' AND co.price_checked_at <= CAST(:now AS timestamptz) AND upper(btrim(coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'declared_market', ''))) = upper(btrim(coalesce(co.market, ''))) AND coalesce(co.offer_payload->>'price_read_source', '') <> 'employee_edit' THEN co.price_checked_at END) END AS row_price_read_at
     FROM catalog_offers co
    WHERE co.product_key = k.product_key
      AND co.suppressed_at IS NULL
      AND coalesce(co.merchant_effective_price, co.list_price) > 0
 ) r
 WHERE r.row_price_read_at IS NOT NULL
PRICE_CHECK_COLUMN_SQL:
SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute
  WHERE attrelid = to_regclass('catalog_offers')
    AND attname = 'price_checked_at'
    AND attnum > 0
    AND NOT attisdropped
) AS present
